h: Peller says Jarvis's sister refused to greet him in his own house
p: Streamer Peller has reportedly called out members of his wife Jarvis's family, saying her sister would not even greet him at home. The claim follows a livestream that ended after an argument over the sister. Jarvis has separately told critics to stop pushing her to respect him.
more: The row began during a livestream that ended abruptly on Friday.
Fans are split between the couple on social media.
Neither family has issued a fuller statement.
